[font=Tahoma][b][size=3]Sexed-up Sandy[/size]

[b][size=2]****1/15/2020: I am committing myself to working on all 3 of my lewd mods to update for changes in SDV 1.5, add seasonal outfits, additional dialogue that is triggered as heart level increases, post-marriage content, heart events, spouse patios, and ( *huge* perhaps) support compatibility for use with Multiple Spouses mod.  I appreciate everyone who chooses to download my mods as I roll out updates and find/fix any bugs or issues you may encounter.  

﻿Due to the NSFW nature of my mods, I struggle to find peeps to help test my mods and help me with errors I have along the way.  Pixel art is also very time consuming for me when creating seasonal and festival outfits.  If you are interested in contributing to the creation of my mods with either pixel art, dialogue, or heart event ideas (Jodi, Sandy, or Caroline) please do not hesitate to contact me by sending me a message on here (I can then give you a way to talk to me on discord), or leaving comments letting me know which of these features you'd like for me to to prioritize (or which of the NPCs for that matter). For bugs and issues comments with error messages are extremely helpful or use the bugs feature.

-WangJangle****[/size][/b][/b]
[size=2]
It's hot in the desert, and so is Sandy.  Buxom lewd Sandy is awaiting you at the oasis, either fully undressed or wearing the outfit of your choice.  

WARNING: The dialogue for this mod is extremely NSFW and sexual.  If you do not want this change, edit the [/size][code][size=2]config.json[/size][/code][size=2] to have the value [/size][code][size=2]"DialogueEdit: false"[/size][/code][size=2].


[b]Update History[/b]

2.0 Refined Nude portrait and multiple outfit options, new sprite options, optional dialogue edits, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3054]Looking For Love[/url]﻿ compatible.

1.3 Nadiki's redone Sandy [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3786]here[/url]﻿ incorporated into portraits.  Nexus update key added to manifest.json.[/size][/font][size=2]

[/font][/size][list]
[*][size=2][font=Verdana]Download and extract any requirements into[/font] [/size][code]Stardew Valley/Mods  [/code]
[*][font=Verdana]Download and extract [code]Sandy Buxom Lewd Portrait and Character Dialogue Overhaul - LfL Compatible[/code]l into[/font] [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]
[/list][list]
[*][font=monospace, monospace][code]Set any parameters you wish in the config.json file[/code][/font]

[font=Tahoma][size=3][b]Config Options[/b][/size][/font]
[font=monospace, monospace]-DialogueEdit: true, false. Makes changes to Sandy's dialogue both vanilla and LfL.[/font]
[font=monospace, monospace]-PortraitStyle: Nude, Bikini, ShortSleeve, BlackHarness, BlackDress, disabled.  Changes the look of Sandy's portrait and can be set to disabled to apply no portrait changes.[/font]
[font=monospace, monospace]-SpriteStyle: Nude, BlackDress, BlackHarness, disabled.  Changes the look of Sandy's character sprite.[/font]
[font=monospace, monospace]-Dateable: true, false.  Sets Sandy as dateable for those not using Looking for Love.[/font]


[size=2][font=Tahoma][b][size=3]Sexed-up Sandy[/size]

[size=2]***Jan 15, 2020:  I am working to update all of my mods to be compatible with SDV 1.5 as well as add seasonal outfits, more heart events (and possible events between characters if all mods are enabled), and extra dialogue.  Also trying to develop post-marriage content.  I struggle to find and fix bugs so I'm grateful to all those who choose to download and test my mods as I release updates throughout this process (and please always report bugs or leave comments so I'm aware of these things).  If you are interested in collaborating on the creation of these mods, please do not hesitate to contact me as I'm unable to use traditional modding communities for help with this kind of content. Thanks!***[/size][/b]
